bca_computer_applications.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Trajectories
bca_computer_applications.summary: BCA graduates in India face a strategic choice: direct corporate entry, specialized 6-month diploma (CDAC), or elite post-graduation (NIMCET for NIT MCA).

paths.name: Direct Tech Entry (Software / Full-Stack / Data)
paths.market_reality: Service MNCs (TCS NQT, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant) hire at ₹3.2 - ₹4.2 LPA. Early-stage product startups or funded Series A firms hire skilled portfolio-backed coders at ₹5 - ₹8 LPA.

paths.name: NIMCET Entrance -> MCA at National Institutes of Technology (NITs)
paths.eligibility: BCA/B.Sc with Mathematics/Statistics as one of the subjects with 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST).
paths.why_it_matters: Bridges academic parity with Tier-1 B.Tech CS grads. Top product tech giants (Amazon, Cisco, Oracle, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs) recruit directly on NIT MCA campuses.

paths.name: CDAC C-CAT Entrance -> PG-DAC (Post Graduate Diploma in Advanced Computing)
paths.why_it_matters: Fast-track 6-month hands-on curriculum without committing 2 years to a Master's degree. Centralized campus placement drive (CCAT) features 150+ tech recruiters.

btech_engineering.title: B.Tech Engineering & Tech Sector Landscape (India)
btech_engineering.summary: B.Tech campus and off-campus placements in India operate across four distinct compensation tiers in 2025/2026.

tiers.hiring_process: National Qualifier Tests (NQT), basic aptitude, foundational programming.

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Funded Startups & Global Capability Centers (GCCs)
tiers.hiring_process: Advanced DSA (Medium/Hard LeetCode), System Design basics, real production projects.
DSA mastery, CS fundamentals (OS, DBMS, Networks), high-concurrency architecture exposure.

gate_pathway.name: GATE Examination (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
outcomes: M.Tech at IISc / IITs (Post-M.Tech average CTC ₹20 - ₹35 LPA)
Direct Recruitment to PSUs (IOCL, ONGC, NTPC, BHEL, PowerGrid) with starting in-hand pay ₹65,000 - ₹90,000/month + residential quarters.

commerce_finance.title: Commerce, Chartered Accountancy & Finance Pathways
commerce_finance.summary: Authoritative compensation and entrance standards across the Indian financial and accounting landscape.

paths.name: Chartered Accountancy (ICAI New Scheme)
paths.market_spread: Standard offers: ₹8 - ₹12 LPA; Big 4 (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG): ₹9 - ₹16 LPA; AIR / Rankers & Corporates: ₹18 - ₹30+ LPA.

paths.name: MBA via CAT / XAT
paths.ctc_inr: Top IIMs (BLACKI): Average ₹32 - ₹36 LPA (Consulting / Investment Banking / Product Management); Tier-2 B-Schools: ₹12 - ₹18 LPA.
paths.investment: Fees ₹22 - ₹27 Lakhs at top IIMs; FMS Delhi remains exceptional value at ~₹2 Lakhs total fees.

paths.name: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst)
paths.relevance: Gold standard for Equity Research, Portfolio Management, and Private Equity in Mumbai, Bangalore, and Gurgaon.

government_civil_services.title: Central Government & Public Sector Banking (India)
government_civil_services.summary: 7th Central Pay Commission standards, allowances, and recruitment procedures for permanent career stability.

options.name: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level Exam)

pay_scales.Pay Level 7 (ASO/Inspector): Basic Pay ₹44,900; Gross with DA+HRA in Class X City (Delhi/Mumbai): ~₹78,000; Monthly In-Hand: ~₹62,000 - ₹67,000

options.perks: Permanent job security, CGHS central medical coverage, regular DA indexation twice annually, predictable promotions.

options.name: Bank PO (SBI PO & IBPS PO)
options.annual_ctc_equivalent: ₹8.5 LPA - ₹10.5 LPA including leased accommodation benefits.
options.culture: Fast-paced retail branch banking, measurable credit targets, accelerated promotional pipeline to AGM/DGM within 12-15 years.

options.name: UPSC Civil Services (IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS)
options.cadre: Group 'A' Central Services with unmatched administrative policy impact, district leadership, and constitutional tenure.

design_creative.title: Product Design & Creative Careers in India
design_creative.summary: India's burgeoning tech and consumer ecosystem has made UI/UX and product design high-paying, portfolio-driven careers.

paths.name: UI/UX & Product Design (Direct Portfolio Path)
paths.core_requirement: Dribbble/Behance/Framer portfolio showing 2-3 end-to-end case studies solving actual Indian consumer/B2B problems with Figma, user research, and interactive prototypes.
paths.growth: 3-5 years experience scales to ₹18 - ₹30 LPA Senior Product Designer roles.

paths.name: NID (National Institute of Design) / CEED (IIT Bombay IDC)
